§6Soyuz-FG Rocket§f

§aThe Soviet-era launch vehicle that gets your payloads into orbit.§f

The Soyuz-FG is assembled in an assembly machine from titanium shells, rubber bars, solid fuel, small and medium thrusters, control units, and 32 low-density elements. It launches from a Soyuz Launch Platform built in the world from concrete, scaffold blocks, and component blocks.

§6Launch requirements§f:
§b• 128,000 mB§f kerosene
§b• 128,000 mB§f liquid oxygen
§b• 750 kHE§f power to the platform
A 30-second countdown plays two alarms before liftoff.

§6Payloads§f: Satellites, orbital modules, and Gerald. The rocket can also enter cargo mode for point-to-point delivery, though that's an expensive shipping method.

§cWARNING:§f All satellites MUST be linked to a satellite control interface with matching frequency before launch. An unlinked satellite goes full freedom and is lost forever.

§ePS:§f The launch platform is large. Budget 4+ stacks of concrete, 7 stacks of scaffold blocks, and 6+ stacks of component blocks.
